name: JVM Heap Memory Usage vs Max (GB)
programText:
(data('jvm_memory_bytes_used', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-controller') and filter('area', 'heap') and filter('service.instance.id', 'kraftcontroller-0')) / 1024/1024/1024).publish(label='Usage')
(data('jvm_memory_bytes_max', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-controller') and filter('area', 'heap') and filter('service.instance.id', 'kraftcontroller-0')) / 1024/1024/1024).publish(label='Max')
